content:
alex: Quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing a "safety matrix" that maps quant profile -> signal thresholds -> fallback action. Idea: track per-model quality delta, token-level logprob delta, eval-set drift, and rollout windows. Thoughts?

 tara: +1. We need contract boundaries for the API. Hosted can do soft degrade; Dedicated/Private must be explicit opt-in for autoswitch.

 jon: How do we measure quality delta in prod? I'd like sampled evals vs golden prompts + a rolling A/B on small slices.

 maria: We have an eval pipeline already. We can add a rolling 24h quality score, but cost is nontrivial. Suggest sampling ~0.1% of requests for full eval.

 alex: Agree on sampling. Telemetry names proposal: quant.quality_delta, quant.logprob_delta, quant.latency_delta, quant.cost_delta.

 sophia: Keep metric names generic: quality.delta, latency.delta, cost.delta. App teams can map these to domain metrics.

 tara: Fallback actions we should support: 1) automated up-quant to safer profile, 2) route to larger model variant, 3) serve cached/heuristic response. Any other?

 jon: For automated up-quant, we need a ramping plan. Immediate switch will cause visible flips. Propose progressive ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% if signal persists.

 alex: Drafting rollout params: "ramp_steps": [0.1, 0.5, 1.0], "ramp_interval_sec": 300. Also require hysteresis/backoff to avoid oscillation.

 maria: Add a contract flag per profile: "can_change_output": boolean. Private customers can set false to block autoswitches that may change output semantics.

 sophia: API surface idea: model config includes "quant_profiles": list of profiles with id,name,bits,type,expected_quality_impact,allowed_autoswitch (boolean).

 jack: infra-bot: Config migration note — need validation in control plane + runtime mapping. Example snippet:

 ```
 {"quant_profiles":[{"id":"q_safe","bits":8,"type":"int8","allowed_autoswitch":true},{"id":"q_aggr","bits":4,"type":"int4","allowed_autoswitch":false}],"autoswitch_config":{"ramp_steps":[0.1,0.5,1.0],"ramp_interval_sec":300}}
 ```

 alex: Also add operational knobs: "rollback_window_sec" and "max_rollbacks_per_hour" to limit thrash.

 tara: For SLOs/alerts: quality.delta > threshold for 3 consecutive windows => SEV3 page and pause autoswitch.

 jon: Tests: add canary lanes that run each quant profile against a known rig and the eval harness; gate rollout on canary pass.

 maria: Privacy note: sampled prompts must be hashed/truncated before storing. Also make sure eval buckets are encrypted at rest.

 sophia: Agree. Also supply an opt-out flag for customers who cannot share any prompt data.

 alex: Next steps — I'll write a follow-up RFC with schema, API changes, rollout matrix and compatibility table. Will ping reviewers tomorrow. :thumbsup:

 tara: lgtm.

 infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled validation job queued for 03:00 UTC — config lint ok.
